A.eligibility: At least two occupied 128 m mask regions
A.target: A deterministic sample of occupied regions at nominal 0.55, at least one and at most occupied minus one; a valid native pixel is a target if its footprint intersects any selected region
A.input: Same-observation QA-valid native pixels outside targets, physical descriptors, complete native grid geometry
A.loss: Huber delta 1, average target pixels in each band, then equal mean over bands with targets

B1.eligibility: At least two optical bands with valid pixels
B1.target: Seeded complete optical bands; one for two bands, otherwise either one or a uniform count between two and C-1 according to the frozen coin flip
B1.input: Unhidden QA-valid bands and immutable geometry; target physical descriptor is available for target-conditioned readout
B1.task_specific_detail: Existing visible same-grid local contrast only for grids with maximum GSD <= 20 m; 5x5 visible-normalized mean, visible band average, target-descriptor scalar gain
B1.loss: Same band-averaged Huber plus 0.2 times the mean per-band squared signed error difference over horizontally or vertically adjacent valid target pairs; empty pair denominator clamped to one

training_reduction: Renormalize configured 0.5/0.5 across eligible tasks within observation, then average eligible observations across both GPUs, including the actual 18-observation tail. Replica gradients are summed before global division and a single AdamW step. Infinity clipping threshold checks finiteness without finite clipping.
evaluation_reduction: MSE averages pixels within target band, target bands within observation, observations within task, then A and B1 equally. High-texture MSE averages band-axis entries with adjacent target pairs in the upper quartile of absolute true contrast, then averages observations.
mask_identity: Frozen seed 17, stable observation ID, task stream hierarchical_A or B1 and epoch/exposure index. VAL always exposure index 0.
data_normalization: Frozen TRAIN statistics, existing QA and native grids. The zero prediction in standardized space is the TRAIN-mean reference.
